text:
Maya: Heads up — CI microbench threshold failed on PR 9034 after merge window. p95 increased ~18% on kv-cache warmup suite.
Sam: saw the alert, digging into the perf CI artifacts now. link: https://ci.redwood/9034/artifacts
Dmitri: repro locally with `./tools/perfbench run --suite=kv-warmup --runs=10`? I want raw numbers.
Sam: running now, attaching output:
```
run 1: p50=42.1ms p95=112.4ms kv_hit=0.67 tokens/s=1280
run 2: p50=43.0ms p95=118.9ms kv_hit=0.63 tokens/s=1234
...
median p95=116.2ms (baseline was ~98.7ms)
```
Linh: interesting that kv_hit dropped ~4-5%. Did kernel autoselect change in that PR?
Maya: PR 9034 touched batcher/heuristics and kernel selector thresholds. Author updated affinity heuristics to prefer fused kernels for long seqs.
Dmitri: that could shift batch composition and KV eviction timing. If batches get longer, KV cache entries may be evicted sooner.
Sam: I ran a flamegraph on the slow run — attaching short snippet: `flamegraph.svg` (uploaded to artifacts). Top hot path is `kv_cache::evict_if_needed` and `batcher::merge_batches`.
Maya: can we bisect to the specific commit? I can trigger `ci-bisect --between=main~10..main` on the perf harness.
ci-bot: bisect started for 9034. Will post candidate commits.
ci-bot: candidate slow commit: 1f4c9b2 (batcher: prefer_fused_on_long_seq) — p95 +16% relative to baseline.
Dmitri: that commit matches my suspicion. The change increases batch merge window which increases memory pressure on KV.
Linh: quick experiment: revert the affinity tweak locally and rerun perfbench. Sam, can you test revert patch `git revert 1f4c9b2 --no-commit` + run suite?
Sam: done. Revert run: p95=99.1ms kv_hit=0.71 tokens/s=1395 — essentially baseline.
Maya: ok looks like a revert is the short-term fix for rollout. We should open a rollback PR and block merge until we have a better batching heuristic.
Dmitri: long term, we need a targeted heuristic: prefer fused kernels only when seq_len distribution > threshold AND kv_cache_pressure low. Also add a unit test simulating kv-capacity to prevent regressions.
Linh: agree. I'll draft a spec: metric rollout guard based on kv_hit and p95 delta.
Maya: I'm going to create the revert PR and a rollout blocker. Also adding the perf artifacts and a short postmortem to the PR.
deploy-bot: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/9041 (revert of 1f4c9b2). Marked as rollback-needed.
Sam: marking this thread for oncall handoff, leaving notes in the rollback PR.
Maya: thanks — followup tasks: (1) add kv-pressure sim test (Dmitri), (2) add metric rollout guard (Linh), (3) run extended perf CI on feature branch before re-merge (Sam).
Dmitri: will also add microbenchmark comparing fused vs generic kernel across seq_len buckets.
Maya: closing loop — this explains the regression and we have a rollback + next steps. :thumbsup:
